name: Forgiveness Of Adultery
overview: Scripture clearly condemns adultery as a serious sin, warning that it destroys the soul and reflects a lack of understanding, as seen in Exodus 20:14 and Proverbs 6:32. Yet, the Bible also reveals God's gracious willingness to forgive and cleanse even the deepest sins, promising mercy and restoration when we repent, as demonstrated in Psalms 51:1 and Isaiah 1:18. This forgiveness is not earned by our own merit but flows from God's lovingkindness, who does not repay us according to our iniquities (Psalms 103:10), allowing believers to delight in Him and receive the desires of their hearts (Psalms 37:4).
